Type: implementation task
Work key: CX06.1
Epic: CX (core curation flow and console polish)
Source: console walkthrough 2026-10-15 (demo data, 1440x900 and 390x844)

Scope: Relationships repeat full sub-XX/... paths on every row, which makes the list long and hard to scan.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Group by subject (and session when present) under a heading; endpoints show paths relative to the group.
2. Link direction, declaring file and unused-fieldmap status remain visible; search/filter by file name works across groups.

Verification: `bash scripts/check-console.sh` (new guarded probes, current source 0 failures) and, where noted, `bash scripts/check-console-backend.sh`.

Starting code:
- modules/http/src/main/resources/sanctity/ui/app.js (relationships tab)
